en.headline: Chow Tai Fook expects interim profit to rise 90 to 100 percent
en.dek: The jewellery group attributed the increase mainly to fair value gains on gold loan contracts and improved sales in core markets.
body: Chow Tai Fook Jewellery Group issued a positive profit alert on Thursday, expecting profit for the six months ended 30 September 2026 to rise by approximately 90 to 100 percent year on year.

The company said the expected increase was mainly attributable to fair value gains arising from the revaluation of gold loan contracts recorded during the period, compared with fair value losses in the same period last year, together with improved sales in its core markets.

For the three months ended 30 September, overall retail value edged down 0.5 percent year on year. Retail value in Hong Kong, Macau and other markets rose 33.2 percent, while the mainland market fell 5.3 percent. Same-store sales in Hong Kong and Macau grew 29.6 percent.
The group opened 23 jewellery points of sale on the mainland and closed 263 during the quarter, and net opened one jewellery store in Hong Kong, Macau and other markets.

zh.headline: 周大福發盈喜 料中期盈利升約九成至一倍
zh.dek: 集團指升幅主要來自黃金貸款合約重估帶來的公允價值收益，以及核心市場銷售改善。
body: 周大福珠寶集團周四發出正面盈利預告，預期截至2026年9月30日止六個月盈利按年上升約90%至100%。
公司表示，預期升幅主要因期內黃金貸款合約重估錄得公允價值收益，去年同期則錄得公允價值虧損，加上核心市場銷售改善。
截至9月30日止三個月，整體零售值按年微跌0.5%。香港、澳門及其他市場零售值上升33.2%，內地市場則下跌5.3%。香港及澳門同店銷售增長29.6%。
期內集團在內地開設23間珠寶銷售點、關閉263間，並在香港、澳門及其他市場淨開設一間珠寶店。
